items.titleEn: What's Heard About the Loans for Artisans?
items.textEn: [Economy.] [—] On Thursday, in the locale of the [kehilla / starostwo] [—], under the chairmanship of the starosta [—], a conference of Jewish and Christian artisans took place; the representatives [discussed] the manner of distributing the loans, in the amount of 300 thousand zł, which the [—] designated for the small-industry (artisans) of the Będzin district. After a longer discussion it was decided that the loans be distributed according to an understanding with the [—] representatives; the size of each loan will correspond to the relevant branch. Besides, on the proposal of the starosta H. [—] Fajnsztajn [?], it was decided to turn with a proper petition to the direction of the "Bank Gospodarstwa Krajowego" in Warszawa, that the designated 300 thousand zł [—]. [—] The economic conjuncture will improve. [—] The money was already paid into the Będzin cash last week. Individual requests will be accepted [—] directly through the "cash" or through the guilds.
